description: This PHP class 'VacancyRestController' provides REST API endpoints for handling vacancy-related HTTP requests within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It handles GET requests to retrieve vacancy details by ID, while POST, PUT, and DELETE handlers are unimplemented, throwing exceptions. The class incorporates validation, normalizer, and service traits, defines route parameters, and manages exceptions for unimplemented and record not found scenarios.

classes.name: VacancyRestController
classes.description: Controller class providing REST API endpoints for vacancy retrieval, implementing GET handling and unimplemented POST, PUT, DELETE methods, with validation and exception handling.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve vacancy by ID, throwing exception if vacancy not found or inactive.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Initializes validation rules for GET request parameters, specifically validates 'id' parameter as positive.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ValidationDecorator instance.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; placeholder for POST validation rules.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; placeholder for PUT validation rules.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException; placeholder for DELETE validation rules.
